title: Improve three-qubit Clifford Gram condition bound to 807 (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas. Improve the sufficient normalized tensor-Gram interval for the full projective three-qubit Clifford alphabet, for every integer width f >= 10.

```diff
- 945/262144 <= eigenvalue <= 762615/32768; condition <= 6456
+ 2835/131072 <= eigenvalue <= 2287845/131072; condition <= 807
```

The new step is an exact affine certificate for the thirty quotient-character types in alephnan’s [PR6714](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6714), pinned at `f7f32a18dde54e67624a9ed9cc7e1b266d9585c0`. It uses the actual transvection character ratios, then the cited reciprocity and Pauli-orbit trace bound. Schur positivity propagates the interval. The two relaxed optima are attained, but actual spectral sharpness is unclaimed. No new κ or threshold improvement.

Credit alephnan for the theorem, multiplicity data and representation-theoretic reduction; Lee–Yu–Peng–Lai for the published character table; Ali Romman for the Clifford framework; MatShep for the sharp small-qubit predecessors; and the lower-bound/open-question lineage retained in the package. No predecessor numerical engine or scientific verifier was replayed.

## Evidence

- The new verifier checks all 30 lower and 30 upper affine inequalities and all 86/138 vertices of the two relaxed trace polytopes. Primal and dual extrema agree exactly. Seven mathematical mutations reject in both normal and optimized Python.
- Two additional private-copy source corruptions reject at the input hash gate. The two retained data files match their exact public source Git blobs. Every generated receipt binds all ten package-file hashes.
- Both registered commands pass locally on CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, in 0.024 and 0.021 seconds. These are replay-budget measurements. AST compilation and whitespace checks pass.
- `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` with source-history validation, and official export/input integrity pass at `c6252da020819a08ef2b2ff14280146c43ad374c`. The read-only export passes both normal/optimized commands with Git unavailable and empty PATH; all 11 exported files, including the export manifest, remain unchanged. The package selector selects this package alone.

Reproduce from the repository root. Any CPython 3.12 interpreter can replace the local absolute path.

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/clifford-transvection-conditioning/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/clifford-transvection-conditioning/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clifford-transvection-conditioning
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/clifford-transvection-conditioning --check-source-history
```

Expected scientific marker: `PASS_CLIFFORD_TRANSVECTION_CONDITIONING`, with `uniform_condition_bound: 807` and the complete generated rational receipt. See `research/clifford-transvection-conditioning/PROOF.md`, `ORIGIN.json` and `VALIDATION.md` for the implication, source hashes and coverage.

## Limitations

The cited PR6714 group identification, published-table identification, width-nine multiplicities, reciprocity and Pauli-orbit trace theorem are inherited mathematical inputs. This contribution proves the new inequalities and their universal consequence; it does not audit those inputs. Convex extremizers of the one-transvection relaxation need not be actual irreducible decompositions. The exact width-ten spectrum remains open.

This is a native-algebra side result, not a finite search failure or a complete multiplication theorem. No physical caller, preparation/restoration tariff, complete recursive invoice or selected supplier admission is supplied. All five selected framework assumptions remain. No selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human review or formal proof-kernel verification is claimed. The task-card scope change is explicit in TASK.json.

## Open next questions

- Determine the actual width-ten endpoints using the two quadratic-form stabilizer decompositions; their extra multiplicity constraints are missing here.
- Add a second phase-correct conjugacy-class trace constraint. First prove its fixed-quadratic-form count and character bound. The one-transvection relaxation is already solved exactly by this certificate.

## Related open work

- [PR6714](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6714) studies the same alphabet and Gram matrix; its threshold ten and multiplicity data are inputs. This improves its sufficient condition bound from 6456 to 807, without claiming sharp endpoints.
- [PR6718](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6718) provides a written review of that predecessor’s even-sector proof and old constants. It supplies separate review coverage, rather than this improved affine certificate.

- [PR6788](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6788) gives an inverse 1-norm envelope under simultaneous absolute row and column caps. Its abstract resolvent class differs from this Clifford tensor-Gram spectral interval; no common numerical norm is computed.

The completion refresh inspected all eight other open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM, #6786 through #6793. None studies this three-qubit Gram matrix or computes a competing spectral endpoint. No additional computations were run to check another contribution.

Targeted open/merged searches, canonical README searches and the live handoff refresh found no overlapping conditioning result. Sparse local notes, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19440708).
